incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired: LATENCY_P99_BURN (service: inference-api) region=us-east-1 p99=2850ms p95=780ms threshold=1200ms :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident 987654 created and escalated to the on-call rotation. Trigger rule: p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/987654
maria (oncall): acking this — joining bridge now. tagging @kevin (eng-sre) and @dave (infra) :eyes:
maria (oncall): quick check — is this global or region-specific?
kevin (eng-sre): looks regional from graphs, us-east-1 node pool showing 95% GPU util and KV cache evictions spiking. I see a stair-step of alerts (autopager waves) at 14:03, 14:06, 14:09 UTC — probably cascading as autoscaler fails to keep up.
dave (infra): confirming, autoscaler logs show repeat scale failures due to quota limit on our quota group: gpu-preempt-1. Attempted scale at 14:05 failed: "quotaExceeded: cannot allocate requested GPUs"
kevin (eng-sre): traffic heatmap shows increased burst from a customer cohort (eu->us-east fallback after eu region degradation) — short-tailed requests, but tail is big. p99 is spiking even though p50/p90 okay.
sara (support): support ops reporting customers seeing "service slow / timeouts" — ~6 support tickets in the last 10m, 2 customers impacted (account-42, account-omega). Marking severity: potential customer impact.
li (pm): ETA on mitigation? We need to know if we should flip global routing fallback to eu or enable degraded-mode pricing/response for affected tenants.
maria (oncall): plan: 1) open bridge (doing now), 2) try temporary routing reroute to eu-backup for non-priority traffic, 3) enable autoscaler manual burst if quota permits, 4) roll small canary to lower-memory model variant for best-effort traffic. If steps fail -> escalate to SRE lead and exec.
incident-bot: Bridge opened: https://meet.example/incident-987654 (maria oncall)
kevin (eng-sre): running quick evict + warm command on KV cache to free memory. Also starting a manual scale attempt (will report). Command: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-us-east-ml --size=12 --zone=us-east1-b```
dave (infra): trying manual quota bump with cloud provider support (request id cp-321). If approved we can add 4 GPUs in ~8-12m.
kevin (eng-sre): while waiting, I'm patching inference-side routing to favor half of traffic to model-quantized-v2 to reduce per-token latency. Patch: ```kubectl -n inference patch svc inference-router -p '{"spec":{"trafficSplit":{"model-quantized-v2":0.5,"model-std":0.5}}}'```
maria (oncall): @kevin please post metrics after patch. Also setting alert threshold escalate to manual page if p99 stays >1500ms for next 3m.
kevin (eng-sre): patch applied. seeing immediate drop in per-token CPU for quantized requests. p99 dropped from 2850 -> 1600ms within first 45s, p95 steady ~700ms. :white_check_mark:
sara (support): adding note to affected tickets: "We are mitigating high request latency in us-east-1; engineering is actively rolling mitigations. ETA 15–30m for stabilization"
pagerduty: Reminder: if incident not acknowledged by primary within 3m, it will escalate to next responder. Current status: acked by maria (oncall).
dave (infra): cloud provider approved quota request cp-321 (partial): +2 GPUs available immediately, +2 pending 10m. Initiating attach: ```provider-cli attach-gpus --region us-east-1 --count 2 --pool inference-gpu-pool```
kevin (eng-sre): attaching nodes to cluster now. Observing node readiness and start of new pods. Warm-up in progress.
maria (oncall): quick customer impact summary for bridge: 6 tickets, 2 customers with timeouts, overall SLO burn ~12% over last 10m in us-east-1. No data leak or error codes, just latency/timeouts.
li (pm): thanks — please flag if any customers need manual outreach. I'll prep comms after stabilization.
kevin (eng-sre): after node attach, p99 now trending 900ms. Still elevated vs baseline but under urgent thresh. KV evictions reduced after cache warm-up.
sara (support): updating tickets: moving to "monitoring post-mitigation". Customers notified that engineering is on it.
maria (oncall): follow-ups: 1) leave routing patch in place for 30m, 2) monitor p99 for 30m, 3) if p99 < 1200ms stable -> close incident, 4) if p99 > 1500 escalate to SRE lead.
kevin (eng-sre): adding a short-lived log rate-limited sampling rule to capture traces for slow requests: ```/ops/run_trace_sampler --rate=0.05 --filter='latency>1000'```
dave (infra): infra note: cloud quota follow-up ticket created cp-321-eta with provider. Need to track permanent pool size vs demand spikes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: Incident 987654 status: acknowledged by maria (oncall).
maria (oncall): declaring 14:28 UTC — mitigation effective, moving to monitoring. handing off to next shift: kevin remains primary for stabilizing. I'll update incident summary and postmortem request.
kevin (eng-sre): I'll keep an eye for 30m and collect traces for postmortem. If it reoccurs I'll escalate.
li (pm): noted — please include traffic heatmap & routing decision logs in postmortem.
sara (support): confirmed tickets updated, set to watch. No new tickets in last 5m.
maria (oncall): handing over full context: autopager waves due to quota + eu->us-east shift; temporary mitigations: routing split -> quantized model, manual GPU attach, kvcache warm + trace sampling. Next: postmortem and quota mitigation plan. :handshake:
kevin (eng-sre): acked handoff. I will post a short summary in #eng-oncall and attach graphs.
incident-bot: Incident 987654 transitioned to MONITORING (mitigation applied).
